analyst_view.overall: A meeting of two struggling sides on Monday night: Monza (Ivan Juric) are 18th with 7 points and have lost four of their last five, while Fiorentina (Paolo Vanoli) are 15th with 9 points after three games unbeaten. Both have scored 17 and conceded 25 in 11 games, so open, leaky games are the norm. Monza rely on Gustavo Varela, the league's top scorer; captain Pessina and Robinson are now fully available, while Folorunsho is still training apart (counted out) and Maye is a doubt. Fiorentina miss Pongracic and Parisi (counted); Njie (thigh) and Ndour (ankle) are doubts and Atta may make the bench. Referee Daniele Doveri, now named, is one of the most lenient in Serie A (2.7 cards a game), and the numbers have already cut cards for him.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, already adding a little for both sides' recent scoring and leaky defending (+2.6% each way). Pessina and Robinson are back for Monza while Fiorentina may miss Njie and Ndour, which roughly balances, so I stay at about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.5 corners, already nudging up for Fiorentina's recent corner count. Monza's wing-back 3-4-2-1 (Birindelli and Mangas wide) and Fiorentina's 4-2-3-1 don't point either way beyond what the numbers see, so I stay at about 8.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards, now cut by 30% for Doveri's lenient record, which I don't size again. This is a relegation scrap the brief carries no stakes flag for: a Monza win would lift them past Fiorentina, which tends to bring more fouls than a usual Doveri game; a mild lean up to about 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots, already raised strongly for both sides' recent shooting (+9% Monza, +13% Fiorentina). I drop last view's small trim: Robinson and Pessina are now fit for Monza, which offsets Fiorentina's doubts over Njie and Ndour, so I stay at about 28.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.0 shots on target, already lifted around 10% for each side's recent form. Varela, Monza's main threat, is fit and Pellegrino leads Fiorentina's line, close to what the numbers assume, so I stay at about 10.
